quests.dispatcherQuestion: A major shipping port reports a large cargo vessel fire threatening nearby fuel storage tanks. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the safety boundary needed around the fuel tanks.
quests.explanation: An exclusion zone keeps people and vehicles well clear of tanks that could be at risk if the fire spreads.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Firefighters need extra foam supplies to safely fight a fire this close to fuel storage. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what specific firefighting resource is needed for a fuel-related fire.
quests.explanation: Foam smothers fuel fires far more effectively than water alone, which can spread burning fuel further.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The vessel fire is extinguished and engineers confirm the fuel tanks were never actually breached. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the tanks are confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Lifting the zone once confirmed safe allows the port to resume normal operations without further delay.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional blood and organ transport network reports a critical delay after severe weather grounds all transport helicopters. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the alternative method needed with helicopters grounded.
quests.explanation: A ground convoy, with a clear route and police escort, can complete the delivery when flying simply isn't possible.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Police need to clear the fastest possible route for the time-critical convoy across the region. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done with traffic along the convoy's path.
quests.explanation: A cleared route keeps the convoy moving without delay, which matters enormously for time-sensitive organ transport.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The convoy arrives at its destination just within the required time window. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what final confirmation completes the operation.
quests.explanation: Confirming successful delivery closes out an operation where every single minute genuinely mattered.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large music festival spanning three days reports a significant rise in heat-related medical incidents on day two. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what resource needs to grow to match rising demand.
quests.explanation: More medical staff on site can treat the growing number of cases without long waits developing into worse outcomes.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Organizers want to add extra free water stations to reduce new heat-related cases. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the preventative measure that reduces future cases.
quests.explanation: Extra water stations prevent new cases from developing in the first place, rather than only treating them after.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The final day passes with heat-related incidents back to a normal, manageable level. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what level of resourcing now fits the situation.
quests.explanation: Returning to standard staffing once demand normalizes avoids keeping unnecessary extra resources on site for no reason.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional emergency call center reports being overwhelmed after a widespread power outage triggers thousands of calls at once. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what backup facility should take the extra calls.
quests.explanation: An overflow center lets trained operators elsewhere help answer calls, so genuine emergencies aren't left waiting on hold.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Operators need a quick way to separate genuine emergencies from general power outage questions. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the process for sorting calls by how serious they are.
quests.explanation: Triaging calls ensures a genuine emergency is never stuck behind routine questions about when the power will return.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Power is restored across the region and call volumes return to their normal daily level. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what happens to the backup facility now.
quests.explanation: Standing the overflow center down once volumes normalize returns operations to their regular, efficient staffing level.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large public celebration in a city square draws double the expected crowd, filling every available space. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to stop the square becoming overcrowded further.
quests.explanation: Temporarily closing entry points stops the square becoming dangerously overcrowded while people already inside are safely managed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Stewards need a safe way to gradually reduce the crowd density in the busiest section. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be added to ease the pressure.
quests.explanation: More exit routes let people leave the busiest section gradually, easing density without a sudden, risky rush.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The crowd has thinned naturally as the evening event concludes without incident. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the crowd has safely reduced.
quests.explanation: Reopening entry points once density is back to normal allows the event area to return to standard operation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A significant industrial accident at a manufacturing plant has released fumes affecting workers across two connected buildings. Input code!
quests.hint: Say exactly which buildings must be cleared right away.
quests.explanation: Naming both connected buildings ensures no one is left in a building affected by shared ventilation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A hazmat team needs to identify exactly which chemical was released to guide treatment for affected workers. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must be determined before doctors can treat workers properly.
quests.explanation: Knowing the exact chemical lets doctors give the right treatment instead of guessing at symptoms alone.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All affected workers are treated and confirmed stable, and the plant is declared safe. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what process should start once everyone is safe.
quests.explanation: A safety review identifies what failed and how to prevent a similar release from happening again.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A significant landslide has isolated a mountain community of two thousand people from all road access for the winter. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the ongoing arrangement needed for a long-term isolation.
quests.explanation: A regular airlift, not a single delivery, ensures the community has reliable access to supplies throughout the winter.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Community leaders report several residents will need ongoing hospital treatment throughout the isolation period. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what recurring transport is needed for ongoing patient care.
quests.explanation: Scheduled medical flights, arranged in advance, ensure residents needing regular treatment don't have to wait for an emergency call.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Spring thaw allows engineers to finally clear the road and restore normal access to the community. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what happens to the winter arrangement now.
quests.explanation: Standing the airlift down once the road reopens returns the community to normal, easier access.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A city-wide public transit signal failure has stranded trains in tunnels at multiple stations during evening rush hour. Input code!
quests.correctAnswer: EVACUATE TRAINS VIA NEAREST TUNNEL EXITS
quests.hint: Say how passengers should leave stranded trains safely.
quests.explanation: Using the nearest tunnel exits gets passengers out quickly without everyone walking the full length of a dark tunnel.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Transit staff need to guide thousands of evacuated passengers safely to street level across the city. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be ensured at each evacuation point.
quests.explanation: Staff at every exit can guide passengers calmly and answer questions, preventing confusion during a large-scale evacuation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers restore the signal system and confirm all trains can safely return to normal service. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can restart once the system is confirmed working.
quests.explanation: Resuming service once fully confirmed working avoids stranding passengers a second time on the same evening.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A major regional hospital reports its backup generator has failed during a city-wide power cut, threatening life-support patients. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what equipment must reach the hospital without delay.
quests.explanation: Immediate generator delivery is the only way to keep life-support equipment running until main power is restored.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Some patients on life support need to be moved to a hospital with working power as a precaution. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the most vulnerable patients as a precaution.
quests.explanation: Moving the most critical patients as a precaution protects them even while temporary generators are being connected.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Main power is restored to the hospital and all transferred patients are confirmed stable. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what final check closes out the emergency.
quests.explanation: A final confirmation ensures every patient, whether transferred or not, is accounted for and genuinely safe.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A prolonged drought has left a farming region's main reservoir at record low levels, threatening the water supply for six towns. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the coordinated measure needed across all six towns.
quests.explanation: Rationing across the whole region, rather than town by town, ensures the remaining water lasts as long as possible for everyone.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Officials need to identify farms most at risk of losing their entire harvest without irrigation. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be directed to farms most at risk.
quests.explanation: Directing limited water to the most at-risk farms first prevents the greatest possible loss to the region's food supply.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Seasonal rains finally arrive and the reservoir begins refilling toward a safe level. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how the earlier measure should be relaxed.
quests.explanation: A gradual lift, rather than an immediate end, avoids reverting to old habits before the reservoir has genuinely recovered.
